description: Lists this workspace’s WhatsApp message templates, one page at a time, with Meta’s review status, whether each can be sent right now (sendable) and, for a rejected one, Meta’s reason. Outside the 24-hour customer service window only an approved template can be sent. Meta reviews every template, and a decision can take up to 24 hours, so one still in review cannot be sent yet. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

category.description: Only this category: marketing, utility or authentication.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

status.description: Only templates in this review state, e.g. approved.

name: list_templates
title: List message templates
